data.one_liner: An interactive SVG-based human body and muscle atlas widget for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Renders high-fidelity anatomical diagrams of the human musculoskeletal system with built-in support for hit testing, dynamic coloring, and custom integrations. It allows developers to handle taps and hovers on specific muscles or groups using stable IDs.
use_when: Building fitness or workout tracking apps
Creating medical visualizations and educational anatomy tools
avoid_when: Needing non-muscle anatomical layers like skeletal, organ systems, or skin which are currently on the roadmap
Needing a non-SVG anatomical rendering solution
strengths: Stable public contract for SVG element IDs across versions
Built-in support for mouse hover on desktop/web and touch interactions on mobile
Aggregate ID support for parts of muscles like digitations
weaknesses: Currently focused only on muscles, lacking organ systems, skin, and bones
Overlapping paths may require fine-tuning for hit-testing
data.setup_notes: Requires proper attribution to Ryan Graves under the CC BY 4.0 license when displaying the assets.
